scientific_integrity: The claim is proved from classical Picard blow-up coordinates and exact integral graph identities; finite incidence steps are independently reproducible using the embedded standard-library checker.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic zero and smooth cubic surfaces only; a formal line-support lattice, not arithmetic Galois descent or actual Picard torsion; older equivalent incidence-group computations may exist; independent audit not performed.
title: The parity–Picard conic-pencil support lattice of cubic surfaces
